summary: Produced a compiled TikZ reconstruction (version 2, best version) of the figure: circle centred at D through A and C (radius ≈236 px), chord A–E–C with E on AC, segments E–D, A–D, C–B–D, A–B, and labels A, B, C, D, E. The latest critic review scored it 0.92 with no must_repair issues; the E label was moved to below-right to clear the arc.
